description: Source code for the 'GameScreen' component of a Tic Tac Toe game built with Flutter. It manages game state, rendering of game board, user interactions, and UI elements such as app bar, status bar, and reset button.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the gameplay screen, including game board, status, and controls.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for this widget.

methods.name: _resetBoard
methods.description: Resets the game board to the initial empty state.

methods.name: _evaluateBoard
methods.description: Checks the current board for a winner or a draw and updates game state accordingly.

methods.name: _onTapCell
methods.description: Handles user tapping on a cell, updating the board if allowed.

methods.name: _statusText
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the current game status.

methods.name: _statusAccent
methods.description: Returns a color indicating the current game status or winner.

methods.name: _isWinningCell
methods.description: Determines if a cell is part of the winning line.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the game screen, including background, board, status, and controls.

methods.name: _buildBoard
methods.description: Constructs the 3x3 game board grid with tiles.
